html:
SMTO-RST-0013 — SMTO wouldn't restart while a task was running

GUID: 2c1bc3ba-6a7b-4da6-ad97-52786c11b89c
Slug: restart-active-task
Domain: RST · Subsystem: rst

What happened

  • A restart of SMTO was refused because a task was still working. SMTO kept running and the task was not interrupted.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait for the running task to finish, or select Stop on it if you don't need it to complete. This refusal happened only because a task was still working when the restart was asked for.
  2. If you stopped a task that was changing files or other systems, check what it already changed before restarting. A stopped task may have done part of its work, and you should know that before anything runs again.
  3. Type /restart in the message box to restart SMTO. Current versions of SMTO allow /restart even while tasks are active, so this should go through.
  4. If this refusal keeps appearing, restart SMTO the way you normally start it, for example by running ./startup.sh again. This message comes from an older version, so the running server may not have been updated yet.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows the restart screen and comes back to Ready.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, and say which version you expect to be running. Don't restart over and over in quick succession while tasks are still working.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The application restart request was refused because task work was active (legacy busy-check diagnostic; current /restart no longer applies this check).

What this means

  • The application restart callback observes application_busy and refuses restart while task work is active. State diagnostics preserve authoritative journal, ownership and effect evidence. They do not delete records, loosen ownership fences, issue SQL or restart/replay work; missing persistence confirmation is separate from in-memory acceptance.

Why this can happen

  • The application restart callback observes application_busy and refuses restart while task work is active.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect active task/owner state and any uncertain external effects before requesting supported shutdown.

How to fix it

  • This message comes from the retired application_busy wrapper; current builds register /restart directly via CommandControlPlane.register and restart even with active tasks. If it still appears, confirm the running Server is the current build; otherwise let active tasks settle or stop them, and check any uncertain external effects before restarting.
  • Let active tasks finish or stop them through existing controls. Inspect uncertain external effects before requesting restart.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Tasks settle or stop through their ordinary controls before restart is admitted.

What not to do

  • Do not use a rapid retry loop or replay an uncertain mutation while waiting for the stated condition.

Technical notes

  • State diagnostics preserve authoritative journal, ownership and effect evidence. They do not delete records, loosen ownership fences, issue SQL or restart/replay work; missing persistence confirmation is separate from in-memory acceptance.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
